answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The plume holds work receipts rather than names, so the jetty of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. By the signal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
